content: Satan Timpielp Jisas Na Eipm Kil Sank
Ekilelel i, Pirpm Wulapm Weinkel apul Jisas mpim yemp kuserel moule karokn arel, apulp na Satan na waker kil yapmunemp na kuapil na yupul yapmunemp'uretelel.
Nompawun Jisas nakantup niepmel ka awun 40-plael i, nilmp amor kil.
Kapepe, Satan la aser kil i nakimpil na, “Kona yikn ka ninkilapm Wulapm Weinkelel, yikn nimplemp wuntokn epe na nisam luwu ntintir.”
Aser Jisas ampu nakimpil na, “Sank ka sil wupm Wulapm Weinkelel, ka nak na, Sank Wulapm Weinkel arai yek nti mentitmaken mintenk. Niepm likekn kakorokn yek nti mintenkel. Karokn.” (Lo 8:3)
Kil nak ntape i, Satan ampu kua kil mpim Jerusalem la yitne suknel Wulapm Weinkel. Satan apul Jisas na misil yitne keipm keipmel.

I Satan nakimpil na, “Kona yikn ninkilapm Wulapm Weinkelel, yikn yukur yo kitapm. Apulpaser sank ka sil wupm Wulapm Weinkelel ka nak na, Kil arai nikimp nti ensel ankilel oko somp yikn sil nta antuel, apulp na wuntokn korokn yump yikn nkaik.” (Buk Song 91:11-12)
Aser Jisas nakimpil na, “Sank ka sil wupm Wulapm Weinkel ka nak antempel na, Wulapm Weink ka niawurpmelip. Yikn korokn timpielpil” (Lo 6:16)
Kapepe Satan ampu kua Jisas mpi namp malenk suknel ka na keipmel at yapel. I kil ntimirempil wopmweink mitinkel ka nuapropm kitapm sukurelel, antempel mpuampua sepmel mitinkel antuel.
I kil nakimp Jisas na, “Kona yikn waker nkaikyimpo eip kitapm i yiki nia apmilelel, arai apm yek yikn mpuampua irpm epe sukurel ka yikn aserel.”
I Jisas nakimpil na, “Satan, yikn nisipm. Sank ka sil wupm Wulapm Weinkelel ka nak na, Kako yikn yiki nia Wulapm Weinkel likekn, kil likekn ka sepmel aiyiknel.” (Lo 6:13)
Eti kil awomp Jisas apmot, pe nti ensel la i wakerpil.
Jisas Apul Niokn Sukur Ankilel

Jisas eipm aser, nti mper Jon apmuei yitne kuretel, i kil awomp yemp suknel Nasaret apmuei. Kil mpim yemp suknel Kaperneam ka ar Galiliel, nti ka nkis sop mpepwarmp mita ar Galili. Kitapm pe nti nkisel, ka ampueik wopmweink antuel nti Sebulun antempel nti Naptali nkisel.

Ka sop sank ampueik Wulapm Weink akei niepm Aisaiael nakel, kil nak na, Nti Sebulun antempel nti Naptali, kitapm antuel ka ar Galili ar yipek yakitie pukn Jordanel. Nti ka sil sop yayapel suknel ka mpi mpepniopmel, pe nti moule wampwamp mitinkelel ka nkis pepe. Nti mentitmaken Sebulun nti Naptaliel ka ar nkis kukokukoel. Aser Wulapm Weink arai yupul yapmunemp antuel na yer mpilil ntinkiraiel (Aisaia 9:1-2) Jisas ka apei Kaperneam, kil ka nakimp nti mentitmaken sank Wulapm Weinkel. Kil nak na, “Kona yipm'a yer nta Wulapm Weinkelel ka piepe, yipm nimimpilemp yapmunemp nisep sankwunamp'uretel apulpaser Wulapm Weink pe kitnanim, kil kana yumulmp yipm.” Kil apul ntakilelel i, Wulapm Weink apul sank Aisaiel pie niminink.
Jisas Aiyimp Kuap Nti Moule Wuyewuyeel

Jisas sop mpepwarmp Galili mita amu i, kil amiser ntiwuye es knuanel Saimon, nia kitie ankilel ka Pita, antempel knuan ankilel Andru. Ntiwuye apul niokn wuntokn akei ntoknpuank nkamp yokn ar mpepwarmp.
Jisas la nankimp ntiwuye na, “Yipmwuye la sop apm. Arai apm ntremp yuwap yipm yayapel nako yipm somp nti moule yimp nti na sop apmel.”
Kapepe, arokn akir, ntiwuye nisep ntoknpuank nkupmus, ntiwuye po mpi misopil.
Jisas mpimpi aser, kil ampu amiser ntiwuye es knuanel nonkel Jems nti Jon antempel waiek antuel Sebedi. Ntiarko pe sil wutumpepel i awomp ntoknpuank ka kakirel. I kapepe Jisas amiyimp ntiwuye,
i karokn akir, ntiwuye nisep waiek ntiwuyeel sil wutumpepel apmuei, ntiwuye po mpi misop Jisas.
Nti Mitinkel, Jisas Ampu Apul Nti Akosepmim

Jisas at aser nti akeiwanto ka ar kitapm Galiliel, i kil muar yank Wulapm Weinkel irpm antuel i yumuap nti ntitmaken sank sepmel apulp Wulapm Weink kana yuwulmp ntiel yer nta ankilelel. Nti mentitmaken ka wule simisimi apul nti kuretelel, kil ampu apul nti sepmim.

Nti ntitmaken ka ar kitapm Siria sukurel eipm sank ampulp Jisas. Kapepe nti wampwampel apul nti moule ka wule simisimi apul ntiel la amiser kil. Nti moule ka nkamp yakop suknelel, antempel nti moule ka muanumpor yanker ar ntiel, antempel nti moule ka mpienyukurel, antempel nti moule ka ntankaik awurel, nti akeiwanto mila. I Jisas ampu apul nti akosepmim.
Pe nti moule mentitmaken mitinkel ka nkarp ar Galili, Dekapolis, Jerusalem, Judia, antempel nti yemp ka ar yek yakitie pukn Jordanel, nti ka sopil.
